steps.what: Define actual target pollutant, water/soil/air conditions and catalyst performance, containment and compatibility requirements
inputs: actual intended pollutant-removal or detection application
actual medium, operating conditions and application constraints
outputs: engineer-defined catalyst design requirements and evidence needs

steps.what: Find and critically read actual nanoparticle catalyst literature, material properties and available experimental evidence in research reference/data software (OPS_SYSTEM)
inputs: engineer-defined catalyst design requirements and evidence needs
actual accessible literature and laboratory/material records with provenance
outputs: engineer-assessed candidate evidence and limits of transfer to the intended medium

steps.what: Design nanoparticle catalysts to detect or remove chemical or other pollutants from water, soil or air, choosing composition, structure, support and operating hypotheses
inputs: engineer-assessed candidate evidence and limits of transfer to the intended medium
actual catalyst requirements and unresolved experimental gaps
outputs: engineer's catalyst design choices and explicit validation needs

steps.what: Write and check the actual catalyst design specification, evidence links, assumptions and intended internal design record
inputs: engineer's catalyst design choices and explicit validation needs
actual supporting evidence and design record identity
outputs: exact completed checked catalyst design specification and internal destination

steps.what: Save the exact checked catalyst design specification in its intended internal design record
inputs: exact completed checked catalyst design specification and internal destination

tasks.design: Configure native search filters and reference views in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the research reference/data system. The engineer reads actual evidence, selects the catalyst design and writes/checks its actual specification in {DOCS} before saving the exact internal design record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated search navigation can obscure relevant catalyst evidence.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved searches and provenance-linked reference views can reduce navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Performance in one medium or experiment does not establish effective, contained operation in the intended application.
tasks.human_edge: Judge evidence transfer and choose defensible material hypotheses.

ambition.what: No unmeasured pollutant-removal performance or automatic catalyst discovery claimed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; research owner validates source access and reference views

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native research reference filters can reduce search navigation while nanoparticle catalyst choices and evidence interpretation remain specialist design work.

assumptions: Unmeasured catalyst design episode. Gross 35 x .10 = 3.5; upkeep 1; net 2.5 hours per 100.
Actual sources are produced by their researchers/laboratories and located/read by the engineer in s2; no free structured material-performance database or newly validated values assumed.

Only navigation changes, with critical reading and all design/specification writing retained. Missing evidence stays a validation need; experimental validation itself is not made free or claimed complete in this design-only proposal.

Same-system save is 1 fully retained point, approximately zero today and no saving. Completed specification/evidence check s4 gates exact internal version/destination; edits invalidate it. No material synthesis or external send is promised.
unknowns: Actual repeated search navigation and existing reference tools
research_questions: Can native filters reduce navigation without suppressing contradictory or medium-specific evidence?

already_counted.description: Requirements, evidence reading, design choices and actual specification/check

incremental.description: Maintain source filters and spot-check provenance and retrieval coverage

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed catalyst design specification, assumptions and internal destination checked in s4; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 reference-navigation scenario below 2.5% modeled net; no scientific design or experimental-runtime saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Save the exact checked coating development record to its intended internal trial record

tasks.design: For the moisture-resistant building-coating route, configure current formulation/test reference views in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the laboratory research record system. The engineer chooses the formulation in {DOCS}, checks the final trial and real laboratory readiness, performs the experiment and writes/checks the actual development record before saving it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Locating current prior formulation and test records adds a small navigation burden.
tasks.enabler_now: Native laboratory reference views can reduce that navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Substrate compatibility, coating behavior and durability require real formulation and experimental work.
tasks.human_edge: Choose useful trials and distinguish a promising result from a supported building-use claim.

ambition.what: No claimed coating performance, laboratory acceleration or product release.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; laboratory owner validates record views and trial authority

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native laboratory reference views can reduce record lookup while nanocoating formulation, preparation, testing and interpretation remain specialist work.

assumptions: Unmeasured formulation/trial episode for one stated coating objective. Gross 15 x .05 = .75; upkeep .25; net .5 hours per 100.

Prior records already exist from actual laboratory work. Engineer captures current formulation/procedure in s2-s3 and actual measurements/record in s4-s5; no free structured recipe or automatic experimental narrative.

All active laboratory preparation, application, testing and interpretation remain. Passive drying/curing or instrument runtime is not focal labour and earns no saving; existing tools already in use earn none.

Final actual recipe, setup and current readiness s3 gate the distinct physical trial s4; any procedure/material/setup/condition change requires renewed check. No unbounded automatic experimental loop is proposed.

Actual trial record is authored and checked in s5 before s6. Same-system save 1 stays fully retained with no saving. Edits invalidate the record gate; no product release or external performance claim is promised.
unknowns: Actual reference lookup burden and existing views
research_questions: Is there measurable repeated record navigation after accounting for actual formulation and lab work?
